title: CIA shut down the reverse-engineering effort in 1989 after no progress

tellings.quote: all I do know is I was given a firm hey in 1989 the CIA shut it all down because nobody us and we know the other companies that we had been found out from our customer didn't make any progress after several decades

plain: A scientist named Eric Davis told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he was told firmly that in 1989 the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, shut down an effort to take apart and copy recovered craft of unknown origin. According to what Davis was told, the companies doing the work had made no progress after several decades. If true, it would mean a secret program existed for decades and failed to crack the technology.
